tha-ap331:1.1: Pupphacchattiya.] Siddhatthassa bhagavato lokajeṭṭhassa tādino / saccaṃ pakāsayantassa nibbāpentassa *pāṇino // //
tha-ap331:2.1: Jalajaṃ āhari*tvāna satapattaṃ manoramaṃ / pupphassa chattaṃ katvāna Buddhassa abhiropayiṃ. // //
tha-ap331:3.1: Siddhattho ca lokavidū āhutīnaṃ paṭiggaho / bhikkhusaṅghe ṭhito satthā imā gāthā abhāsatha: // //
tha-ap331:4.1: ‘Yo me cittaṃ pasādetvā pupphacchattam *akārayi / tena* cittappasādena duggatiṃ so na gacchati.' // //
tha-ap331:5.1: Idaṃ vatvāna sambuddho Siddhattho lokanāyako / uyyojetvāna parisaṃ vehāsaṃ nabham uggami. // //
tha-ap331:6.1: Vuṭṭhite naradevamhi setacchattam hi vuṭṭhahi / purato Buddhase*ṭṭhassa gacchati cha*ttam uttamaṃ // //
tha-ap331:7.1: Catunavute ito kappe yaṃ chattam abhiropayiṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi pupphacchattass' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap331:8.1: Catusattati kappamhi aṭṭha Jalasikhā ahuṃ / sattaratanasampannā cakkavattī mahabbalā. // //
tha-ap331:10.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Pupphacchattiyo thero i. g. a-ti.
